---
title: "Stories and Reports"
description: "A sample Quarto listing page for UNICEF-style stories, reports, and narrative publishing."
listing:
  id: story-list
  contents: posts
  type: default
  sort: "date desc"
  fields: [image, date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
  categories: true
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: [title, description, categories]
  page-size: 6
  image-height: 220px
---

<p class="lede">This sample listing page now follows Quarto's blog-style pattern by automatically listing content from the `posts/` directory. Add a new post folder with an `index.qmd`, render the site, and it will appear here automatically.</p>

## Featured Content

:::{#story-list}
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Listing note"}
Quarto listings work best when every story page has a clear `title`, `description`, `date`, `categories`, and, when possible, a meaningful `image` and `image-alt` value.
:::
